race.comment: VAREJAO (5) is first-up here but has been on the doorstep of a maiden victory placing in eight of 11 career efforts and this is not an overly strong affair. Revved up for this with a recent trial win and has placed two from three when fresh. Rates highly in this line-up. IT'S KAOS (13) returned in good order with a close-up third at Ispwich and will have come on with that run now under the belt. Gets in well at the weights with the 3kg claim and is nicely placed to go a couple better. PICK THE LOCK (11) is facing the starter for the first time but looked handy winning a recent trial and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside marble. Respect any market confidence. JUNGLE WONDER (4) hasn't been too far away at the past couple and may earn some minor money. SWAGGERING (1) best of the rest while fresh.
